events.title: Navy Football vs. Towson — home opener

events.title: Foodees Food and Culture Festival

events.title: Rockville Farmers Market

events.title: Takoma Park Farmers Market
events.description: The year-round Sunday farmers market sets up behind the Shops on Laurel Avenue, with the entrance next to the bank.

events.title: First Friday Dupont Circle ArtWalk

events.title: Del Ray Artisans Hispanic Heritage opening reception
events.description: Opening reception for the free community art exhibit Celebrating Hispanic Heritage: Voices Through Visuals in Del Ray.

events.title: Ken Carson: xperimenting tour

events.title: DC JazzFest at The Wharf — Saturday

events.title: DC JazzFest at The Wharf — Sunday finale

events.title: DC JazzPrix Finals
events.priceLabel: Sold out; check source for returns

events.title: Elevation Rhythm: Washed Tour — Saturday

events.title: The Wailin' Jennys

events.title: John Cafferty and The Beaver Brown Band
events.description: John Cafferty and The Beaver Brown Band, of Eddie and the Cruisers soundtrack fame, play the Birchmere.

events.title: Danny Gatton birthday celebration

events.title: Bethesda Summer Concert Series: Soul Crackers

events.title: Victoryland and Drook

events.title: All White Party: a tribute to the music of Frankie Beverly
events.description: A tribute show celebrating the music of Frankie Beverly and Maze plays The Hamilton Live's downstairs stage.

events.title: Jiaoying Summers: Lucky Pony 26 — Friday

events.title: Jiaoying Summers: Lucky Pony 26 — Saturday

events.title: DC Improv Stand-Up Showcase

events.title: Darius Bennett
events.description: Detroit comedian Darius Bennett, known from Netflix's Introducing series, headlines The Cellar at Comedy Loft DC.

events.title: Gruesome Playground Injuries — Friday
events.priceLabel: $55 adults plus $5 fee; $45 seniors and students
events.description: Rajiv Joseph's two-hander about a friendship shaped by decades of injury and reunion plays its closing weekend at Keegan.

events.title: Gruesome Playground Injuries — Saturday
events.priceLabel: $55 adults plus $5 fee; $45 seniors and students
events.description: The Saturday-night performance of Rajiv Joseph's intimate two-character drama during its final weekend at Keegan.

events.title: Gruesome Playground Injuries — closing matinee
events.priceLabel: $55 adults plus $5 fee; $45 seniors and students
events.description: The final performance of Rajiv Joseph's drama about two friends who keep meeting in hospital rooms across thirty years.

events.title: Glenstone Saturday extended hours
events.description: The last Saturday of extended summer hours until 8 PM at the modern and contemporary art museum, its pavilions and grounds.

events.title: State Fairs: Growing American Craft — closing week

events.description: The first major exhibition on craft artists' contributions to U.S. state fairs shows more than 240 works in its closing week.

events.title: Nick Cave: Mammoth

events.title: Tomorrow the Sun Will Rise: 2026 juried exhibition

events.title: Glen Echo Labor Day Art Show — opening day

events.title: Global Rhythms — Labor Day weekend showcase
events.description: A free showcase of international music, dance and storytelling performances runs throughout the park for Labor Day weekend.

events.title: Bumper Car Squares — Labor Day weekend square dance
events.venue: Glen Echo Park Bumper Car Pavilion
events.priceLabel: $12 advance; $15 same day; kids 12 and under free
events.description: A beginner square-dance lesson followed by live-music dancing; no partner needed and kids 12 and under dance free.
events.sourceName: Glen Echo Park Partnership for Arts and Culture

events.title: Kreeger Museum public docent tour — Friday

events.title: Kreeger Museum public docent tour — Saturday
events.description: The Saturday docent tour walks through Monet, Picasso and Kandinsky works in the Philip Johnson house on Foxhall Road.

events.title: Pennsylvania Avenue: The Good, The Bad and The Glorious
events.priceLabel: $35; $30 with federal or DC government ID
events.description: A two-hour guided walking tour of Pennsylvania Avenue's architecture and history from the White House to the Capitol.

events.title: Outdoor film at the REACH: Zootopia 2
events.venue: The REACH at the Kennedy Center
events.description: A free outdoor screening on the REACH's video wall; bring blankets or chairs, no registration needed.

events.title: Mount Vernon Gardens and Landscapes tour

events.description: A guided walk through George Washington's ornamental and kitchen gardens with an estate horticulture specialist.

events.title: George Washington whiskey tasting
events.address: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Hwy, Mount Vernon, VA 22121

events.title: Critter Chow: meet the park's animal ambassadors
events.venue: Sky Meadows State Park Visitor Center

events.title: The Butterfly Experience conservatory — final weekend

events.title: First Saturdays at Sky Meadows historic area
events.venue: Sky Meadows State Park historic area
events.description: The monthly living-history day opens the 1840s Mount Bleak House and shows hearth cooking at the log cabin.

events.title: Barnyard Buddies: feeding time on the farm
events.venue: Sky Meadows State Park historic area
events.description: Kids help feed heritage-breed chickens and goats the way a 19th-century Sky Meadows farmer would have.

events.title: Roving Ranger on the Potomac beaches
events.address: 2001 Daniel K. Ludwig Dr, Woodbridge, VA 22191
events.description: A park educator roams the picnic area and Potomac beaches with live animals or historic artifacts to share.

events.title: Junk Slam Dunk Potomac shoreline cleanup
events.address: 2001 Daniel K. Ludwig Dr, Woodbridge, VA 22191
events.description: A family litter-collection challenge along the Potomac shoreline, with a popsicle voucher for participants.

events.title: Mill in Motion: waterwheel grain grinding

events.title: Boar's Head Resort Labor Day celebration — Sunday road trip
events.priceLabel: $40 per vehicle, all passengers; free for hotel guests
events.description: Yard games, food trucks and a Beatles tribute band close with a 200-drone light show, a standout way to end the weekend near Charlottesville.

events.title: Plant A Park Fest — Sunday road trip
events.description: An all-day music and artisan-vendor festival with two headline bands raises funds for Scott's Addition's first public park.
